Hi Matt —

Nice to meet you on Friday. Per our conversation, I put together a brief mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns the evaluation milestones with legal/procurement gating so we can get to an order form quickly once the pilot looks good. High level:

- Week 0–2: Eval (API pilot + runbook).
- Week 1: SOC2 and DPA evidence shared with your security team.
- Week 2: Procurement/legal review of MSA/DPA + order form redlines.
- Week 3: Sign & enter dedicated trial/commitment.

Can you confirm that HelixCare can run the eval during the week of June 16 and that procurement will be available for a short review during week of June 23? If procurement/legal needs anything specific up front (example: custom DPA clause, PO template, or longer evidence window), flag it now so we can parallelize.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners and dates), SOC2_summary_2024.pdf.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm pilot start date and procurement contact.
2) We share the SOC2 and the DPA redline template with your legal team.
3) We schedule a 30-min sync on June 17 to align owners.

Thanks — I’ll loop in legal once we have a procurement contact.

— David

- We can start the pilot week of June 16.
- Procurement contact: procurement@helixcare.com (cc’d).
- Legal will want to review the DPA; SOC2 evidence is required.

A couple of asks from our side to avoid blockers:

2) We typically need a PO-friendly order form template and an idea of standard payment/payment terms (net 30 vs net 45).

Happy to join the June 17 sync.

Hi Matt / HelixCare procurement —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the procurement contact. A few items from legal:

- We can provide the SOC2 Type II report under NDA. I will coordinate with compliance to send the full report to your security contact (please confirm the recipient email for secure transfer).
- For the DPA: our standard DPA is broadly acceptable for most healthcare customers; if you have a specific clause you need added, please indicate the clause and we will triage.
- Payment terms: our default is net 30; we can discuss net 45 if required by procurement, but that does impact invoice cadence for reserved capacity deals.

I've attached a short list of the most common redlines we accept and the places where we need a business-approved exception. If HelixCare can mark up those points this week, we’ll aim to have a legal response within 3–5 business days.

Attaching: DPA_standard_redlines.docx.

Team —

Quick sequencing note to keep the playbook tight (I’ll join the June 17 sync):

- Parallelize: start pilot (June 16) + share SOC2 to Helix security (June 16).
- Legal review window (June 17–20): Laura to review Helix redlines; we’ll accept standard DPA changes that do not touch data residency or deletion obligations.
- Procurement alignment (June 23): procurement finalizes PO template and payment terms.
- Target sign date: June 26–27, assuming no substantive DPA negotiations.

If HelixCare needs an exec-level credit/commitment or SLA exceptions, that will require escalation and add ~1 week. For this deal (HLX-2025-1784) my recommendation is to keep to standard clauses and push order form finalization.
